name: Padmanabh Alloys & Polymers Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Padmanabh Ltd is in the business of filled and reinforced Rermoplastic compounds and masterbatches.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) PL manufactures mineral-filled and reinforced thermoplastic compounds, mineral master batches, synthetic paper master 
batches, glass-reinforced thermoplastic, and other specialty master batches. 
b) It also offers special additive master batches to enable plastic process themselves to create tailor made products. 
c) The company also produces tailor-made 
products as per the specifications given 
by the customer.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.06 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 6.68% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 3.74% over last 3 years.
Debtor days have increased from 104 to 134 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -18.5%
